title: Yoga
tagline: Union of body, mind, and spirit
description: Understand the core philosophy of yoga as a complete system for stilling the mind and reconnecting with your innermost self.

sutra.meaning: Now begins the discipline of Yoga. Maharishi Patanjali has gifted us his treatise on Yoga in a codified form.

sections.insight: This is a sacred beginning. When there is readiness the journey unfolds naturally.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Self-disciplined is needed in areas which are not so pleasant to start with but give joy in the long term ie. Sattvic matters. Am I willing to persue the not so pleasant?
sections.practice: Find a quiet and comfortable place to sit and set a time for daily practice.
sections.meditation: Sit quietly and set an intention,3 min breath awareness and 10 min meditation.

sutra.meaning:
Yoga is the stilling of the fluctuations of the Consciousness ie Chitta. The Chitta comprises of the Manas, Buddhi, Ahamkar. The mind, intellect and ego.
Then the seer abides in their true nature.

sections.insight:
The mind keeps moving. Awareness—not suppression—brings stillness. Yoga shows us how. 
When the mind settles you experience your true self—peaceful and aware.
sections.reflectionPrompt: When is my mind most restless?
sections.practice: Observe thoughts without reacting. I should watch like I hawk which thoughts are frequent visitors.
sections.meditation:
3 min breathing. 
Pause and observe moments of stillness. meditate for 10 min
sections.shlokaFrom:
2.48 yogastha kuru karmani sangatyaktva dhananjaya,
sidhyasidhyoh samo bhutva samatvam yog uchyate. Bhagwadgita
sections.wisdomFrom:
Be steadfast in the 
performance of your duty,
 O Arjun, abandoning
 attachment to success
 and failure. Such 
equanimity is called Yog.

sutra.meaning:
Discipline in practice, self-study, study of the scriptures and surrender to God are the acts of yoga.
Yoga reduces suffering and prepares for meditation.

sections.insight: I need to be committed to make progress
sections.reflectionPrompt:
Can I make a commitment to myself?


Effort + awareness + surrender = growth.	Am I balanced in effort?
sections.meditation: 10 mins meditation with intention to be comitted

sutra.meaning: Practice of yoga removes impurities and brings wisdom
Eight limbs of yoga guide the path
